description: A LEAN algorithmic framework that implements a basic 'future-testing' quantitative strategy scaffold for A-shares. It uses a coarse and fine universe selection to pick top 10 stocks by market cap with positive EPS, generates alpha signals via 10/30 SMA crossovers, constructs an equal-weighted portfolio with T+1 sell constraint, applies a 10% maximum loss risk control, and simulates execution with Chinese stock market fees (0.03% commission + 0.1% stamp duty on sells, lot size 100).

parameters.universe: Coarse + Fine fundamental selection, top 100 by market cap, price > 10, EPS > 0

risk_controls: Maximum loss per position: 10% (sell when loss exceeds 10% of average cost)
T+1 constraint: stocks bought today cannot be sold on the same day (enforced in portfolio construction)
